decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the firm's core map.apps platform, and four rapid releases show the firm can absorb user feedback and iterate on it, so it fits the existing knowledge base.

The hierarchical search bundle is a small plugin close to the established map.apps offer and is cheap to maintain, though it is only mentioned on the website and could be folded into the general search functionality.
VueTOC builds on the firm's mobile and web mapping expertise and was presented as a new solution approach, but as an experimental component it could later be absorbed into other products.
The software platform is the flagship that draws directly on the firm's core GIS engineering knowledge and research, so it is central to the firm's strategic direction.
Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's GIS competence and serves both public and private customers, and it has its own page signalling commitment.
The search extension complements the firm's web map apps and rests on knowledge the firm already holds, so maintaining it costs little.
